notes: `שֵׂיבָה` → *a good old age* heads on *old*, since *age* alone is any age (rule 31), the attributive keeping its own *good*.
The two Np tokens of `אֲבִי הָעֶזְרִי` are one name and share a unit carrying the chain's *of* and the *the* the ASV writes for the segmented article (rules 19, 29, 30).
